pages.text: In order to obtain The Lost Eye, you must defeat the Chaos Spawner, a sealed skull contained within a large glowing box waiting for a curious adventurer to break the seal.

pages.title: Labyrinth Map
pages.text: The Labyrinth can spawn at any distance from the spawn point. They can be located with dungeon maps, which are obtained from Monster room chests.
To break the seal, the player will have to use the Skull of Chaos in front of the boss, which will make a screeching noise awakening the Chaos Spawner.
